Tetraglyme is implicated in targeting Low affinity cationic amino acid transporter 2, which is a target of Isatin and Rutin, both of which also target C8166. This indicates a possible pathway where Tetraglyme may influence C8166 via these intermediate targets. The scores from the three paths, though varying slightly, all point to a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with Tetraglyme being a central node in the network connecting to C8166 through multiple targets. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, as the pathways are not fully characterized. The integration of these findings suggests that Tetraglyme may exert its effects on C8166 through a series of biochemical interactions involving cationic amino acid transporters and their downstream targets.
